name: Lake Bamboo Flute
description: Breath-first bamboo flute with velocity-driven blowing pressure. Air starts immediately, then the bore tone builds. Soft/medium notes settle on the played pitch; firm attacks briefly overblow and fall back; hard blows sustain the octave while held. The octave mode suppresses fundamental/odd partials and excites its own harmonic series. A pressure-peak/settling model approximates flute behavior; not a full fluid/waveguide simulation. Best E3–E5, playable to D6. Five compatible controls and dry Stereo Output.
